name: recruitment-negotiation-demo
description: Three-agent negotiation demo: Webex Task Agent + Webex Scheduling Agent + mock Workday Recruiting Agent, negotiating a candidate interview slot.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix workday-recruiting-agent-mock && npm install --prefix webex-task-agent && npm install --prefix webex-scheduling-agent && npm install
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n workday,task,scheduling -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start:workday" "npm run start:task" "npm run start:scheduling"
